Title: problem with rest params and function overloading
Description: ``` ts
export function injection(clazz: Class)
    export function injection(...metadata: Metadata[])
    export function injection(...value: any[]) {

        if (typeof value === typeof []) {
            return (clazz: Class) => {
                Injector.instance.register(clazz, value);
            }
        }
        else {
            Injector.instance.register(<any>value);
        }
    }
```
